priorityList: Keep Instant Poison applied and maintain Slice and Dice at all times.
Maintain Blade Flurry whenever 2 or more targets are present.
Cast Roll the Bones if no buffs are active or if you only have one buff.
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, ideally when not at maximum Combo Points.
Cast Keep It Rolling if you have 2 or more Roll the Bones buffs active.
Use Finishers (Between the Eyes, Coup de Grace, Dispatch) when at 6 or more Combo Points.
Cast Between the Eyes as your priority finisher to maintain its critical strike buff.
Cast Coup de Grace as a priority finisher if Disorienting Strikes is active.
Cast Killing Spree as a finisher at 6 or more Combo Points.
Cast Dispatch as a filler finisher if no other finishers are required.
Cast Blade Rush on cooldown to maintain Energy flow and deal AoE damage.
Cast Ambush whenever Hidden Opportunity and Audacity procs are active.
Cast Pistol Shot when Opportunity is active, especially if at high Fan the Hammer stacks or to build Combo Points.
Use Vanish to proc Hidden Opportunity when you do not have Audacity or Opportunity buffs available.
Use Sinister Strike as your primary builder when no other procs or builders are available.
